Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add probability filters to Bloodhound and modal popups to Zone Scanner

Bloodhound Scanner:
- Add wall activity classification \(ACTIVE/ENGAGED/DORMANT/UNKNOWN\)
- Add multi-timeframe alignment scoring \(intraday + swing bias\)
- Add tier system \(HIGH_CONVICTION, WATCH, FILTERED\)
- Only alert HIGH_CONVICTION setups to reduce noise

Zone Scanner:
- Add clickable modal popups for expanded ticker details
- Fetch live price on modal open
- Fix close button overlapping price display

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Remove separate velocity Telegram alert

Velocity info now only appears in the Bloodhound alert signals list.
One message instead of two - cleaner, less noise.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
